# runzero_api_key (Resource)

Manages a RunZero API key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment for the API key.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization UUID to scope the key to.
- `rotate` (String) Arbitrary keeper value. Changing it rotates the API key token.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `counter` (Number) Total usage counter.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the API key was created.
- `created_by` (String) Email of the user who created the key.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the API key.
- `inactive` (Boolean) Whether the API key is inactive.
- `last_used_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the key was last used.
- `last_used_ip` (String) IP address from which the key was last used.
- `last_used_ua` (String) User agent string from the last use.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The API key token value.
- `type` (String) The type of the API key.
- `usage_limit` (Number) Maximum allowed usage.
- `usage_today` (Number) Usage count for today.
